summary: This 6-K filing by Royal Philips (Koninklijke Philips N.V.) reports the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. Shareholders approved all proposals, including the appointment of a new Supervisory Board member, re-appointments of existing board members and the CEO, ratification of financial statements, and standard governance items. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of a regular AGM outcome. It does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. No transaction terms, prices, or strategic review are present, making this a non-event regulatory filing.
